verdict.rationale: Feitian keys are marketed as W3C WebAuthn/FIDO2-compliant HID devices with passwordless Azure AD/Windows Hello support and 'no limit to accounts registered' (implying discoverable credential storage), which strongly implies resident key/passkey support, but no evidence pack item explicitly states discoverable credentials, resident key capacity limits, or username-less sign-in flow testing. missing for 10: explicit documentation of resident key/discoverable credential support and storage limits, independent/hands-on verification of usernameless login flow, FIDO2 certification listing showing rk=1 capability.
